question: Where do all beings abide?
premises: The great all-pervading wind ever abides in space.
So all beings are in me.
Thus know all beings to be my abode.
inference: All beings abide in the speaker, just as wind abides in space.
uncertainties: No textual uncertainty identified from the supplied gloss; the compound parsing is taken as given.
plain_english: Just as the great, all-pervading wind ever abides in space, so know that all beings abide in me.
